scope: Field-level source review for all 37 historical issue groups, covering 38 official printings. This evidence changes neither runtime registration nor Standard legality.

evidence_checks.artwork_review: Dated visual review of the matching official card images, documented in docs/CATALOG_REVIEW.md. No automatic preference for accessibility labels or new inferred source values.

preservation_contract: Never overwrite raw gallery records, structured values, accessibility values, original HTML, or historical issue records.
Verify the immutable reviewed origin archive independently. Its hash identifies evidence; it does not require a refreshed candidate page to have identical markup.
Apply each effective field only if the complete version1 parsed-printing hash, typed raw field prerequisites, source image URL, and exact local evidence hashes match.
A changed candidate printing or corrupt or missing evidence fails explicitly before output files are replaced.
Preserve the distinction between artwork-confirmed observations and four rule-derived exclusions of unprinted Device tags.
Confirming missing-type fallbacks is not permission to accept other missing domains or unreviewed fields.
Metadata resolution does not set playable_in_client or implement cards, and does not alter presets or training recipes.
Preserve absence as null for unreviewed statistics. Protector’s Shield raw Might 1 is not a unit base stat; its existing might_bonus 1 and equipment effect remain separate and unchanged.
Live page checks fetch current gallery and legality pages but do not freshly download image evidence; the stored visual review remains dated.
